Nick, saw Anaqua acquired Patrix, adding nearly 400 IP management customers and deepening your law-firm and European reach.

I built a personalized signal play for Anaqua off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings the North America team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
